_comment: The health check's knowledge-graph probes (specification 2.5 item 6.1). Each ASK must return true. If the BMM gains or loses a class, update the count here deliberately. 34 to 39 at S521: S0.4 (8d2b5df, S518) added AxisPrecondition, AxisTransition, CanonicalRuntimeType, StatusAxis and ValueSpace.

probes.name: BMM metamodel has its 39 classes
probes.ask: PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> ASK { { SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH <urn:ontara:stack:kg:ontara-bmm> { ?c a owl:Class . FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?c), "https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/")) } } } FILTER (?n = 39) }

probes.name: BMM class ServiceOffering sits under a BFO parent
probes.ask: PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { GRAPH <urn:ontara:stack:kg:ontara-bmm> { <https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/ServiceOffering> a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ?parent . FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?parent), "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/")) } }

probes.name: Platform record module defines PlatformRecord
probes.ask: PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> ASK { GRAPH <urn:ontara:stack:kg:ontara-record> { <https://ontara.dev/ontology/record/PlatformRecord> a owl:Class } }
